verdict.rationale: Codex CLI supports a dedicated 'review' command that reports prioritized findings against uncommitted changes, commits, or a base branch without modifying the working tree, and cloud tasks can be started from GitHub PRs and result in opening a pull request. However, there is no evidence of automatic, native GitHub PR-triggered review comments integrated into the PR UI itself—review is invoked manually via CLI/cloud task rather than automatically on every PR.
